original_report:
Pass 4/10 is complete: all 73 assigned artifacts were read through EOF. I found these concerns; the README concern carries over from pass 1.

- **[P1] `collaborative/source.py:195–224, 260–267`** — Capture and freshness checks verify changed blobs but do not open unchanged blobs referenced by the pinned trees. A missing or corrupt unchanged blob can therefore leave `review_status` at `peer_complete`. An oversized unchanged blob can also be admitted, then prevent completion of the `source_tree` listing. Validate those referenced blobs at capture and recheck, and refuse an over-limit snapshot at opening.
- **[P2] `codex_bridge/engine.py:219, 234–259`** — An SDK task that cancels itself is treated as caller cancellation and re-raised, so the call can end without the required structured uncertain response. Distinguish internal task cancellation from cancellation of the caller.
- **[P2] `codex_bridge/sdk.py:111–124`** — If the interrupt task ends with `CancelledError`, `task.result()` bypasses the `except Exception` block and skips `client.close()`. Record the interrupt failure and still attempt close within the remaining deadline.
- **[P3] `README.md:5–7`** — The introduction says the live walkthrough is blocked by the removed Codex MCP endpoint, while the SDK-based walkthrough is recorded as successful. Update that description.

No canonical verdict was submitted. The next step is the assigned source reading pass 5/10.
